evidence_items.locator: Adopting Order paragraph 1; Consent Decree paragraphs 2(h), 17–20 and Attachment 1
evidence_items.explanation: The decree responded to calls using a cloned Biden voice to discourage primary voting and imposed continuing verification, training and reporting duties. Its August 2024 effective date and 36-month term place those duties in force on May 16, 2025; the event date describes that continuing legal obligation, not a new enforcement action.
